description:
Perform a comprehensive image asset inventory of https://books.toscrape.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Crawl https://books.toscrape.com/.
2. Navigate to the 'Images' tab to view image assets.
3. Export the complete image list to a CSV file named 'image_inventory.csv' in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
4. Analyze the data and create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/image_optimization_strategy.txt' containing:
   - Total image count.
   - Breakdown of formats (e.g., how many JPGs vs PNGs).
   - Identification of the top 3 largest images by file size.
   - A brief optimization recommendation (e.g., 'Convert to WebP').
